rules.rule: Audit edits and commits nothing and runs no agent case
No target means every skill the diff against the base touches
must: No target is every skill the diff against the base\s+touches

rules.rule: For all or a group, propose the budget and stop until confirmed, before any tier runs, the cheap ones included
must: stop until the user confirms,\s+before any tier runs, the cheap ones included
Once the target is confirmed or needs no confirmation, run probes

rules.rule: Cheap tiers run without asking; before any agent case state the list and estimate and ask, whatever the size
must: state the case list,\s+the count, and the estimate, and ask — whatever the size

rules.rule: Never write a target skill's LESSONS.md or lessons store; name corrections for skill-enhance
must: Never write a target skill's `LESSONS\.md` or lessons store

rules.rule: Fix writes the test before the edit; a probe must fail at the base
Fix stages only its own files, writes the message through craft:cm, never pushes
must: stage only the files this improvement changed

rules.rule: Token fixes move condition-triggered prose to references, never drop a rule
One fix and one rerun per FAIL; a second FAIL reverts and goes to the user
must: One fix and one rerun per FAIL; a second FAIL reverts the improvement

rules.rule: A repo without the group layout gets a read-only review against the authoring standard
must: gets a read-only review of each `SKILL\.md` against\s+\[authoring\.md\]

rules.rule: Agent cases run on the default model with -j 4; no sonnet first pass
A round stops at its cap; cases and re-runs not run are reported open; more needs a new yes
must: At the cap, stop: report the cases and re-runs not run as open;\s+running them needs a new yes
